title: 第680章 东陵主宰降临第679章 北境的主宰们
slug: 全族助我加点我举族飞升天界
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：全族助我加点，我举族飞升天界第二卷：北玄领主第680章东陵主宰降临（..la）黑幽主宰只是短暂打量了一眼李北玄，很快便将目光移开。
不过随着黑幽主宰的到来，会场之中的阵营已然是泾渭分明。
黑幽主宰独自一人。
李北玄与天都主宰一路，月华主宰与太安主宰以及万花主宰站在一起。
车渠主宰与久枯主宰一道，夜陇主宰以及赤燊主宰站在另一边。
剩下的青雉主宰与云影主宰则是位于中间。
李北玄看着会场之中的这些主宰，心中对一众主宰的阵营已经已经有了大概。
眼下已经有十二位主宰到场，整个北境一共十三位主宰，现如今也就还差东陵主宰还没降临。
他算算时间，应该也快到了！
“天都道友，这个站位便是这次东陵小会的各大阵营了吗？”李北玄看向一旁的天都主宰传音道。
天都主宰点了点头，“不错，黑幽主宰向来独来独往，况且以他的实力也不屑与与他人结盟！”
“我等这次泛海古迹之行，需要注意的是车渠主宰和久枯主宰两人，同时还有夜陇主宰和赤燊主宰！”
见李北玄不解，天都主宰继续传音解释道，“因为他们的目的与我等的目的一样，都是想要谋划天渊神心！”
“所以我等与他们之间乃是竞争关系！”
听到天都主宰这么说，李北玄心中了然。
泛海古迹之中允许竞争，想要资源得拿出实力来。
“天都道友，我明白了！”
传音间，他的目光也不由得看向那两个阵营。
恰好与车渠主宰对上。
只见车渠主宰的脸上却是带着一抹淡淡的笑容。

眼神之中有着若有似无的审视之意。
李北玄收回目光，在刚刚相互认识的交谈之中，他便已然打量了一众主宰。
全都是深不可测之辈。
至少每一个都是资深主宰，并不是他这个方才突破十多万年的新晋主宰所能比拟的。
所以，面对自己这个新晋主宰，他们更多的只是好奇。
至于要充当他们的竞争对手，想来他们也并不会将之放在心上。
李北玄暗暗将车渠主宰与久枯主宰，还有夜陇主宰和赤燊主宰暗暗记下。
毕竟等东陵小会之后的泛海古迹之行，可还要警惕他们的组合。
虽说只是正常的竞争关系，但处于警惕李北玄依旧是存在防备之心。
就在这时，天都主宰继续传音道，“东陵主宰要来了！”
听到天都主宰的传音，李北玄顿时收回杂念，他目光静静看向前方。
果然没过多久，一道身影从虚空缓缓显现出来，站在了会场的最前方。
显现出来之人乃是一位儒雅随和的中年，眉心之处则是有着一枚紫晶印记。
李北玄顺着目光看去，眼眸微微一凝，心中暗道，“这位便是东陵主宰了吧！”
仅仅一眼，便知晓这位东陵主宰乃是深不可测的存在。
东陵主宰像是察觉到了李北玄刚刚的打量之意，目光似有若无的扫视了一眼李北玄所在。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: The whole clan will help me add some points, and I will ascend to the heavens. Volume 2: Lord Beixuan Chapter 680 The Lord of Dongling Arrives (..la) The Lord of Black Nether just briefly looked at Li Beixuan and quickly looked away.
However, with the arrival of the Black Lord, the camps in the venue have become clearly divided.
The Lord of Darkness is alone.
Li Beixuan stood with the Lord of Tiandu, and the Lord of Yuehua stood with the Lord of Tai'an and the Lord of Ten Thousand Flowers.
Lord Chequ and Lord Jiuku stood together, while Lord Yelong and Lord Chishen stood on the other side.
The remaining Blue Pheasant Master and Cloud Shadow Master are located in the middle.
Li Beixuan looked at the masters in the venue and already had a rough idea of ​​the camps of the masters.
There are already twelve masters present, and there are a total of thirteen masters in the entire northern region. Now only the master of Dongling has not yet arrived.
He calculated the time and it should be almost there!
"Fellow Daoist Tiandu, is this position the major camps of this Dongling meeting?" Li Beixuan looked to the side and said to the Lord Tiandu who was transmitting the message.
Lord Tiandu nodded, "Yes, Lord Black Nether has always been a loner, and with his strength, he doesn't even bother to form an alliance with others!"
"While I'm on this trip to the ancient ruins across the sea, I need to pay attention to the Lord Chequ and Lord Jiuku, as well as Lord Yelong and Lord Chishen!"
Seeing Li Bei
"So there is a competitive relationship between us and them!"
Hearing what the Lord of Tiandu said, Li Beixuan understood in his heart.
Competition is allowed in Oceanwide Ancient Monuments, and if you want resources, you have to show your strength.
"Fellow Daoist Tiandu, I understand!"
During the sound transmission, he couldn't help but look at the two camps.
Just in time to face the master of Chequ.
I saw a faint smile on the face of Chequzhu.
There was a hint of scrutiny in his eyes.
Li Beixuan withdrew his gaze. During the conversation where they had just gotten to know each other, he had already looked at the masters.
They are all unfathomable people.
At least every one of them is a senior master, and they are not comparable to him, a new master who has just broken through more than 100,000 years.
Therefore, facing their new master, they were more just curious.
As for being their competitors, I guess they don't take it to heart.
Li Beixuan secretly wrote down the Master of Chequ and the Master of Jiuku, as well as the Master of Yelong and the Master of Chishen.
After all, we have to be wary of their combination when we wait for the trip to the Panhaiic monuments after the Dongling Xiaohui.
Although it was just a normal competitive relationship, Li Beixuan was still on guard.
At this moment, the Lord of Tiandu continued to send a message, "The Lord of Dongling is coming!"
Hearing the message from the Lord of Heaven, Li Beixuan immediately put away his distracting thoughts and looked forward quietly.
Sure enough, not long after, a figure slowly appeared from the void and stood at the front of the venue.
The person who appeared was an elegant and easy-going middle-aged man, with an amethyst mark between his eyebrows.
Li Beixuan followed his gaze, his eyes narrowed slightly, and he thought to himself, "This must be the Lord of Dongling!"
With just one glance, one could tell that the Lord of Dongling was an unfathomable existence.
The Lord of Dongling seemed to have noticed Li Beixuan's sizing up just now, and glanced at Li Beixuan's location with a vague gaze.
